en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph seen through a pointed Gothic archway, looking into a narrow courtyard that appears to be part of an old church or monastery cemetery. In the foreground is an ornate wrought‑iron cross or gate attached to a tall grave monument. Along the right wall there is a medieval-looking stone arch/relief set into the plastered wall. A stair with a perforated brick balustrade rises to an upper level covered with vines, and in the background is a stucco building with a Baroque-style window under a tiled roof.
